description: Fan-like pleated shape — used for frills, crests, fins, and decorative collars. Alternating folds create an expandable fan.

foldRecipe.description: Mountain-fold along the first vertical grid line to start the pleat
Valley-fold along the next vertical grid line to create the first pleat pair
Alternate mountain and valley folds across the remaining grid lines to form the full fan
Squash-fold the base to gather and lock the pleats together
